items.title: Payment demanded by debt collector (unverified claim)
items.quote: Der Betrag ist binnen 4 Tagen, das heißt bis spätestens 11.04.2025, auf das Sonderkonto IBAN SK20 1100 0000 0029 4512 3456 (Empfänger: R. Horváth, Verwendungszweck ZFB-25-0407-118) zu überweisen.
items.computation: The letter gives a calendar date, 11.04.2025. It also says 4 days from 07.04.2025, which also gives 11.04.2025. 11.04.2025 is a Friday, so no weekend adjustment is needed. The date is used as printed.

warnings: Probable scam or abusive demand: a very short 4-day deadline, threats of wage garnishment and credit bureau entries, and a claim that objections will no longer be processed.
The payment goes to a foreign (Slovak) IBAN held by a private person (R. Horváth), not to the company named in the letterhead. This is a typical sign of fraud.
The letter is addressed to 'Sehr geehrter Schuldner' and does not name the creditor's address or give a contract date or invoice number. The claim is not itemised or explained.
The costs look inflated: 96.00 EUR in collection fees and 22.80 EUR for address research on a 149.90 EUR claim.
A Vollstreckungsbescheid can only be issued after a court Mahnverfahren, and you would have a right to object to it. The letter's claim that objections are no longer processed is wrong.

Do not pay yet. Check whether you ever had a 'Glücksmuster Premium' subscription, and ask for proof of the claim in writing. Consider contacting a consumer advice centre (Verbraucherzentrale) or the police.
The letter is dated 07.04.2025, and today is later than that. The stated payment date has already passed.
